description: New Mexico-only rules checked against the cited statutes and Motor Vehicle Division pages. National rules stay in the baseline. No fines.

questions.q: New Mexico's speed when passing a school while children are going to or leaving school, if the school zone is properly posted, is
questions.explanation: Section 66-7-301(A)(1) NMSA 1978 says no person shall drive faster than fifteen miles per hour on all highways when passing a school while children are going to or leaving school and when the school zone is properly posted.

provenance.manual: New Mexico Statutes Annotated

questions.q: In a New Mexico business or residence district, the statutory speed is
questions.explanation: Section 66-7-301(A)(2) sets thirty miles per hour in a business or residence district. Subsection C says the speeds in subsection A may be altered as authorized in Section 66-7-303.

provenance.manual: New Mexico Statutes Annotated

questions.q: On a New Mexico county road that has no posted speed limit, the statutory speed is
questions.explanation: Section 66-7-301(A)(3) sets fifty-five miles per hour on a county road, as defined in Section 66-7-304, without a posted speed limit.

provenance.manual: New Mexico Statutes Annotated

questions.q: Driving a commercial motor vehicle in New Mexico is unlawful at an alcohol concentration of
questions.explanation: Section 66-8-102(C)(2) makes it unlawful to drive a commercial motor vehicle with an alcohol concentration of four one hundredths or more in blood or breath within three hours of driving, from alcohol consumed before or while driving.

provenance.manual: New Mexico Statutes Annotated

questions.q: If a New Mexico driver under 21 has an alcohol concentration of two one hundredths or more,
options: there is no license consequence until eight one hundredths
driving privileges shall be revoked under the Implied Consent Act
the license is suspended for 30 days
the only result is a written warning
questions.explanation: Section 66-8-110 says that when a person is less than twenty-one and the blood or breath contains an alcohol concentration of two one hundredths or more, driving privileges shall be revoked under the Implied Consent Act. That administrative revocation is separate from the eight-one-hundredths criminal rule in 66-8-102.

provenance.manual: New Mexico Statutes Annotated

questions.q: Each traffic conviction or adjudication during a New Mexico instruction permit
options: adds 30 days to the permit period
has no effect on the permit period
questions.explanation: MVD Chapter 4 says the applicant must have held an instruction permit for at least six months, provided that thirty days shall be added to the six months for each adjudication or conviction of a traffic violation committed while driving with an instruction permit.

provenance.manual: New Mexico Motor Vehicle Division

questions.q: The MVD learner's-permit page also says that before Stage 2 the applicant must
options: keep a clean record for 90 days
questions.explanation: The MVD page on applying for a learner's permit lists, among the steps before a provisional license, maintaining a clean driving record for the 90 days preceding application for Stage 2. Chapter 4 separately adds 30 days of permit time per traffic conviction.

provenance.manual: New Mexico Motor Vehicle Division

questions.q: A New Mexico instruction permit is available at 15 if the applicant is in or has completed driver education with a DWI component, and the supervisor must be
questions.explanation: MVD Chapter 3 says a person 15 or older who is enrolled in and attending, or who has completed, an approved driver-education course that includes a DWI component may apply for an instruction permit. The permit allows driving when accompanied by a licensed driver 21 or older who has been licensed at least three years and who occupies a seat beside the driver, except on a motorcycle.

provenance.manual: New Mexico Motor Vehicle Division

questions.q: Before a New Mexico provisional license, the practice driving must be at least
questions.explanation: MVD Chapter 4 requires a practice driving component of not less than 50 hours of actual driving, including not less than 10 hours of night driving. Chapter 3 says a parent or guardian must certify in writing that those hours were completed. The applicant must also be at least 15 and one-half and have held the permit at least six months.

provenance.manual: New Mexico Motor Vehicle Division

questions.q: A New Mexico provisional licensee may have, as passengers under 21 who are not immediate family,
options: any number if they wear seat belts
questions.explanation: MVD Chapter 4 says a provisional licensee may be accompanied by not more than one passenger under the age of twenty-one who is not a member of the licensee's immediate family.

provenance.manual: New Mexico Motor Vehicle Division

questions.q: In New Mexico, what is the youngest age at which you can get a learner's permit for a car?
questions.explanation: New Mexico issues a learner's permit for a car at 15 years at the earliest.
questions.remember: New Mexico car permit: 15 years at the earliest.

provenance.manual: Chapter 3: Instructional Permit | Motor Vehicle Division NM

questions.q: In New Mexico, how long must a driver under 18 hold a learner's permit before moving to the next license?
questions.explanation: New Mexico requires drivers under 18 to hold the learner's permit for 6 months.
questions.remember: New Mexico: hold the permit 6 months.

provenance.manual: Chapter 3: Instructional Permit | Motor Vehicle Division NM

questions.q: Of a New Mexico teen's required supervised driving hours, how many must be at night?
questions.explanation: New Mexico requires at least 10 hours of the supervised driving to be at night.
questions.remember: New Mexico: 10 hours of the supervised driving at night.

provenance.manual: Chapter 3: Instructional Permit | Motor Vehicle Division NM

questions.q: In New Mexico, what is the youngest age at which a teen can get a license to drive without a supervisor?
questions.explanation: In New Mexico, the earliest unsupervised (provisional) license is at 15½ years.
questions.remember: New Mexico: driving alone from 15½ years.

provenance.manual: Chapter 4: Provisional Driver’s License | Motor Vehicle Division NM

questions.q: During which hours may a newly licensed teen in New Mexico not drive without a supervisor?
questions.explanation: New Mexico restricts provisional drivers from Midnight to 5 a.m., with exceptions such as work or school.
questions.remember: New Mexico new drivers: off the road Midnight to 5 a.m..

provenance.manual: Apply for a Learner’s Permit | Motor Vehicle Division NM

questions.q: In New Mexico, what is the youngest age for a full, unrestricted car license?
questions.explanation: New Mexico drivers can hold an unrestricted license at 16½ years.

provenance.manual: Chapter 1: Definitions | Motor Vehicle Division NM

questions.q: What score do you need to pass the New Mexico car knowledge test?
questions.explanation: You need 70% to pass the New Mexico car knowledge test.
questions.remember: New Mexico car test: pass with 70%.

provenance.manual: Chapter 11: Road And Written Test Requirements | Motor Vehicle Division NM

questions.q: In New Mexico, a driver 21 or older is legally impaired at what blood alcohol concentration?
questions.explanation: In New Mexico, drivers 21 and older are over the limit at 0.08% or more.
questions.remember: New Mexico, 21 and over: 0.08% is over the limit.

provenance.manual: General DWI Information | Motor Vehicle Division NM

questions.q: In New Mexico, a driver under 21 breaks the law at what blood alcohol concentration?
questions.explanation: New Mexico sets the under-21 limit at 0.02%.

provenance.manual: Apply for a Learner’s Permit | Motor Vehicle Division NM

questions.q: In New Mexico, how long is the license suspension for an adult's first refusal of a breath or blood test?
questions.explanation: A first refusal in New Mexico brings a suspension of 1 year.
questions.remember: New Mexico, first refusal: 1 year without a license.

provenance.manual: General DWI Information | Motor Vehicle Division NM

questions.q: What is the highest standard speed limit for cars on rural interstates in New Mexico?
questions.explanation: Rural interstates in New Mexico can be posted up to 75 mph for cars.
questions.remember: New Mexico rural interstate: up to 75 mph.

provenance.manual: SB0125 Final (NMSA 66-7-301)

questions.q: How is New Mexico's seat belt law for adults enforced?
options: Primary: police can stop you just for not wearing a seat belt
Secondary: police can cite you only after stopping you for something else
No seat belt law for adults
questions.explanation: New Mexico seat belt enforcement is primary.
questions.remember: New Mexico seat belts: primary law.

provenance.manual: Seat Belt Law | Motor Vehicle Division NM

questions.q: What is New Mexico's minimum liability insurance (injury per person / injury per crash / property damage)?
questions.explanation: New Mexico requires at least $25,000 / $50,000 / $10,000.

provenance.manual: Insurance | Motor Vehicle Division NM

questions.q: Under New Mexico's point system, what is the lowest point total that can suspend an adult's license?
questions.explanation: New Mexico can suspend an adult's license at 12 points in 12 months.
questions.remember: New Mexico suspension: 12 points in 12 months.

provenance.manual: Guia Para Conducir de Nuevo México (official MVD Spanish manual)
